summary.zh-Hant: 樞密院司法委員會裁決拉布拉多邊界：爭議地區幾乎全歸紐芬蘭
summary.en: Judicial Committee of the Privy Council decides the Labrador boundary, awarding practically the whole disputed territory to Newfoundland

citations.evidenceNote: 標題頁：「Report of the Lords of the Judicial Committee of the Privy Council, delivered the 1st March, 1927」。結論：「the boundary between Canada and Newfoundland in the Labrador Peninsula is a line drawn due north from the eastern boundary of the bay or harbour of Ance Sablon as far as the fifty-second degree of north latitude, and from thence westward along that parallel until it reaches the Romaine river, and then northward along the left or east bank of that river and its head waters to their source and from thence due north to the crest of the watershed or height of land there, and from thence westward and northward along the crest of the watershed of the rivers flowing into the Atlantic Ocean until it reaches Cape Chidley」。
citations.gradeBasis: 樞密院司法委員會的裁決書本文（裁決機關自己的文件；對兩方而言都是第三方的官方紀錄）。Claude 看掃描圖逐字抄錄，2026-11-14，待複核。

citations.locator: p. 1036, Appendix, 3. The Labrador Boundary Award
citations.evidenceNote: 「The long-standing controversy between the Dominion of Canada and Newfoundland with regard to their boundary in the Labrador Peninsula was, by consent of both parties, referred to the Judicial Committee of the British, Privy Council for decision. On March 1, 1927, this decision, awarding practically the whole territory in dispute to Newfoundland, was announced.」
citations.gradeBasis: 加拿大官方年鑑記載裁決結果（對加拿大不利的一方自己的官方記載）。裁決本文尚未取得。

timeNote.zh-Hant: 裁決書 1927-03-01 宣讀。資料庫裡加拿大、紐芬蘭的疆界紀錄照資料集在 1927-03-11 換段，和裁決日差十天，原因還沒查（可能是樞密院令的日期），所以這個事件沒有接成那些紀錄的起訖事件。
timeNote.en: Report delivered 1 March 1927. The border records switch on 1927-03-11 (dataset date); the ten-day difference is unexplained (possibly the date of the Order in Council), so this event is not linked as their start or end event.
